interpretation_limits: Eight training sources only; not validation/test generalization.
No learned energy, VLM guidance or deployment-safe selector was trained.
All trial acceptance and stopping use GT; computation includes rejected trials.
No-harm is relative to the FP32-state current output, not a guaranteed fallback to original BF16 output.
Step-4 and step-8 trajectory reports are identical because all trajectories stopped by step 4.
STE has exact deployment forward values but approximate derivatives.
Finite directions, amplitudes and one window are not a global oracle upper bound.
